title: Eleven Minutes of Silence
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：way　|　正文 397 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 way 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The worst job in our school was the telephone. Every afternoon one of us sat in the office and rang the homes of children who had not come in, and the ① way we were told to do it was brisk: name, reason, date of return. I was terrible at it. My ② way was to apologise first, which took eleven minutes a call and got me into trouble every day.

Mrs Okonkwo, who ran the office, had a different ③ way: she said nothing at all for the first ten seconds. She said the silence was the whole ④ way of the thing — that a parent who has been rung by a school has already decided what the call means, and no ⑤ way of beginning can undo that decision except waiting it out. In the ⑥ way of these things, she was right and I was not, and it took me a year to admit it.

What the job taught me, slowly, was that a ⑦ way of speaking is not a technique but a temperament. I had assumed that being kind was a matter of wording; it is mostly a matter of pace. The brisk way and the apologetic way cost the same in minutes and very different amounts in trust. On the ⑧ way home that evening I counted the calls I had made and the ones I had dreaded, and trust, I decided, is the only currency an office like that has.

In my last week I made the call I remember. A boy had been absent nine days; the number rang out twice; on the third try his grandmother answered and said he was in the garden. I asked whether I could speak to him. She said no, and then, after a pause of exactly the kind Mrs Okonkwo used, said he had been in the garden since Tuesday and would be ⑨ in the way until his mother came home. Nobody had told us anything for nine days because nobody had asked the right person.

I have worked in three schools since and I have never again been asked to make those calls. Mrs Okonkwo retired in 2017 and the job was given to a computer, which is ⑩ by way of being an improvement: it leaves a message, it wastes no minutes, and it has never once waited ten seconds to find out what a silence was hiding.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 方式；方法（the way of doing）
B. n. （某人的）作风；习惯做法
D. 固定搭配：in the way of 关于；在……方面
E. 固定搭配：in the way 挡道；碍事
F. 固定搭配：by way of 作为；算是（by way of being）
H. n. 情形；情况（the way of these things）

items.q: the way we were told to do it
My way was to apologise first
the whole way of the thing
In the way of these things
a way of speaking is not a technique
On the way home that evening
would be in the way until his mother came home
which is by way of being an improvement

answers.why: the way of doing 意为“做……的方式”，指办公室规定的那套说法。
指“我”自己的“作风、习惯做法”，即先道歉，故每通电话要十一分钟。
同样指个人的“做法”，说 Mrs Okonkwo 用的是另一套。
the way of the thing 意为“事情的关键、情形所在”，说沉默就是全部要害。
way of beginning 指“开场的方式”，说除了等待没有别的方式能扭转印象。
in the way of these things 意为“在这类事情上”，引出她对我错。
a way of speaking 指“说话这方面、说话的样子”，说它不是技巧而是性情。
此处 way 指“路、道路”，on the way home 意为“在回家的路上”。
in the way 意为“碍事、挡道”，此处说孩子一直待在花园里碍事。
by way of being 意为“算是、作为”，说电脑接管算是一种改进。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们被要求的方式很干脆：姓名、原因、返校日期。（the way）
我的做法是先道歉，这要花十一分钟。（way）
她说沉默才是事情的关键所在。（the way of the thing）
除了等，没有哪种开场方式能扭转那个印象。（way of）
在这类事情上，她是对的，我错了一年才承认。（in the way of）
电脑接管算是一种改进：它从不空等十秒。（by way of）
answers: The way we were told to do it was brisk: name, reason, date of return.
My way was to apologise first, which took eleven minutes a call.
She said the silence was the whole way of the thing.
No way of beginning can undo that decision except waiting it out.
In the way of these things she was right, and it took me a year to admit it.
The computer taking over is by way of an improvement: it never waits ten seconds.
